description: This header file defines interfaces and structures for handling chunk-based file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and locating chunks within the file.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a 'chunkfile' structure for reading or writing, depending on the provided hashfile pointer.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a 'chunkfile' instance.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in the specified chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a chunk to the chunkfile with specified id, size, and write function.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes out the entire chunkfile data.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads the table of contents from a memory-mapped chunk file.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Locates a chunk with specified id and provides its position and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Finds a chunk by id and processes it with a provided callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the object id algorithm.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
